$comment: The pinned oasdiff release that CI runs on openapi/v1.json (design.md, Technical decisions: T12), with the SHA-256 of each release archive from the release's checksums.txt, which tools/repo-checks/src/oasdiff.ts verifies before it runs anything from the archive. A new version is pinned only after the 7-day release age, through a reviewed pull request.
